apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 and later, built on Cemu: PowerPC interpreters, an AArch64 recompiler, Cafe OS HLE and a native Metal renderer under a SwiftUI app with a measured Wii U GamePad layout. Some MeloCafe cores and bug fixes have been brought over to MuffinEMU.

This source serves the standard build for SideStore, AltStore and LiveContainer, which re-sign it with your own Apple ID at install.

Bring your own games and keys. No copyrighted content is distributed here.

MuffinEMU, Wii U emulation for iPhone and iPad, built from commit 005fd9a675479afffd15c7bf14c7b077d5b4153d.

**`MuffinEMU.ipa`** - SideStore / AltStore / LiveContainer. Unsigned; they re-sign
with your own Apple ID at install.

**`MuffinEMU-fakesigned.ipa`** - TrollStore or jailbroken only, with the JIT
entitlements embedded.

The recompiler needs a JIT enabler (StikJIT, SideStore, LiveContainer) and the
"Use the recompiler (JIT)" switch in Settings; without both it runs the
interpreter. `MuffinEMU.app.dSYM.zip` is only needed to symbolicate a crash report.

MuffinEMU is built on Cemu. Some MeloCafe cores and bug fixes have been brought over to MuffinEMU.

## What's fixed in this build

- **The whole app freezing when you hit pause** - pausing suspends every guest CPU
  thread under the core's own scheduler lock, and that call was running synchronously
  on the main thread (both from the pause button and from the auto-pause-on-background
  handler). If a guest thread holding that lock was itself waiting on something that
  only resolves once the main thread's run loop is free - a Metal command buffer
  completion handler dispatched back to the main queue is exactly this shape - the main
  thread and the guest thread wait on each other forever: not a slow pause, the whole
  app stops responding to anything, pause button included. Both call sites now run on a
  dedicated background queue instead, so the main thread never blocks on this.

## What's fixed in this build

- **Rendering/gameplay freeze** - a failed JIT arena allocation (a `vm_remap` failure)
  was silently getting overwritten back to "recompiler enabled," so every code-gen
  request after that failed forever while audio/input kept running. Now falls back to
  the interpreter cleanly when the arena genuinely can't be allocated.
- **Screen Layout ported from MeloCafe** - Single Screen / Adaptive (Both Screens) /
  GamePad-top-right, arranging the TV and GamePad on this device's own screen. Lives in
  Settings > Display alongside the existing external-display routing. Comes with a
  swap button in Single Screen mode.
